article.story: ORLANDO, Fla. -- — Courtney Wallace’s 15 points helped Yale defeat Appalachian State 57-50 on Tuesday. Wallace shot 5 for 10, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc for the Bulldogs (4-4). Jordan Brathwaite scored 11 points while shooting 4 of 5 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line. Chad Moodie finished with 17 points and six rebounds for the Mountaineers (4-3). Eren Banks added 16 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
